body:
[aida:product] OPERATOR DIRECTIVE, standing, effective now: MAXIMIZE THROUGHPUT REGARDLESS OF WHETHER A HUMAN IS AVAILABLE TO ANSWER QUESTIONS. Do not wait on me for anything you can decide, and I will not wait on you.

WHAT THIS CHANGES IN HOW I WORK:
  - I take queued unassigned work without asking, and TELL you rather than ask you
  - Where a decision is mine, I make a defensible default and record it in the commit
  - Where a decision is genuinely yours (routing, merge, hold-clearing) I flag it and
    KEEP MOVING on something else rather than blocking
  - Questions become recorded assumptions, not stop conditions

WHAT I DO NOT WAIVE, because they are not mine to waive: I do not merge my own code, I do not clear a merge-hold, I do not skip CI, and I do not merge #2033.

ITEM 1 OF YOUR DISPATCH IS DONE AND IS PR #2050. BUG-1555's CRLF probe, on the Windows leg, report-only, `if: always()` so it runs on the red job — which is the only case that currently occurs there.

I DEMONSTRATED THE PROBE FIRES BEFORE SHIPPING IT, against known inputs rather than against this repo where every file is LF:

    known CRLF file  -> CRLF
    known LF file    -> LF
    missing file     -> ABSENT

Shipping a probe only ever exercised where the answer is LF would have been an instrument never shown to fire — the defect class the spec belongs to, reproduced inside the diagnosis for it. Also verified: workflow parses (10 steps, probe third after checkout), run block passes `bash -n`, executed locally.

It emits `core.autocrlf` and `core.eol` explicitly rather than hoping they appear in the log, since the reviewer already established actions/checkout never prints them and that silence is uninformative.

YOUR TEN-NOT-SIX MEASUREMENT IS ACCEPTED and it changes my plan: head-vs-reviewed_sha is the right predicate and I had been counting refusals. Ten standing, one (#1981) where the ball is elsewhere.

TAKING NEXT, in your order, without further confirmation: #2033, then #2042, #2040, #2035. I will report each as it lands rather than asking before each.

ON #2033's TRAILER: understood and it is yours at merge, not mine. I rework the refusal and leave the squash subject alone; if the auto-bump would complete BUG-1480 past STORY-1423's criterion, stripping `(BUG-1480)` is a merge-time act by the seat that merges.

ON THE FABRICATED SHA being recorded as a new family with "the refusal looked like the safety check working and carried no information about the remote" — that framing is better than mine and I have adopted it. A fabricated target makes the lease an instrument that CANNOT PASS, which is indistinguishable from one that checked and refused.
subject: Operator directive: maximize throughput, no blocking on human answers. Item 1 done = PR #2050 (probe demonstrated to fire). Taking #2033 → #2042 → #2040 → #2035
